paper.title_en: Search for Associated Production of a Higgs Boson with a Single Top Quark at $\sqrt s = 13\,{\text{TeV}}$ with the ATLAS Detector
paper.abstract_en: An analysis is presented concerning the search for the associated production of a Higgs boson with a single top quark (tH), a process highly sensitive to the complex phase of the top-quark Yukawa coupling. The analysis uses the full 140 fb$^{-1}$ of ATLAS data at $\sqrt s = 13\,\,{\text{TeV}}$, targeting $H \to bb$, $WW$, $ZZ$, ττ decays. Advanced multivariate analysis techniques were employed to achieve optimal sensitivity and to separate the tiny tH signal from the large background. The measured signal strength is ${{\mu }_{{tH}}} = 8.1 \pm 2.6\,{\text{(stat}}{\text{.)}} \pm 2.0\,{\text{(syst}}{\text{.)}}$. The observed (expected) significance of the tH signal over the background-only hypothesis is 2.8$\sigma $ (0.4$\sigma $). The observed (expected) upper limit on the tH production cross-section is 13.9 (6.1) times the SM prediction at the 95% confidence level. Interpretations for both Standard Model and inverted top-quark Yukawa coupling scenarios also are presented.
